item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J03360","case1_error":"Correct formulas are followed by an unsupported final answer of 6186; they imply 859 balloons per school.","case2_error":"Evaluates (1/4) × 3 × 14 as 14 instead of 10.5 cups.","reason":"Case 1 supplies an unsupported number after correct formulas; case 2 explicitly miscalculates a correctly written expression.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J03361","case1_error":"Gives an unsupported final answer of 19 after correct formulas that imply 9 additional plants.","case2_error":"Assigns the friend's 40% share to John, who owes the remaining 60%, or $1200.","reason":"Case 1 has an unsupported numerical conclusion; case 2 confuses whose payment percentage applies.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J03362","case1_error":"Models five children and five adults instead of three children and two adults.","case2_error":"Equates Rehana's future age to three times Phoebe's current age, omitting Phoebe's five-year aging.","reason":"The erroneous relations have distinct mechanisms: incorrect ticket multiplicities versus mixing current and future ages.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J03363","case1_error":"Counts only one sandwich instead of two and evaluates its listed sum as $30.25 instead of $32.25.","case2_error":"Divides by servings per batch twice, reducing the required 15 batches to 7.5 before rounding.","reason":"Case 1 omits a purchased item's multiplicity and misadds; case 2 repeats a conversion from servings to batches.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J03364","case1_error":"Provides an unsupported final value of 200 after correct formulas implying a $600 increase.","case2_error":"Adds the six sold cows instead of subtracting them, producing 95 instead of 83.","reason":"Case 1 does not show how its incorrect number was obtained; case 2 explicitly reverses the effect of selling cows.","judgment":"different"}]}
